entries.67bfff471b2a72b4: K'S HOLDINGS CORPORATION forms a group with nine subsidiaries and franchised member stores and operates multiple stores as a consumer electronics retailer. The company purchases merchandise centrally at its head office. The companies that operate stores are the company itself, Gigas Co., Ltd., Kansai K'S Denki Co., Ltd., Big S Co., Ltd., Hokuetsu K'S Co., Ltd., Kyushu K'S Denki Co., Ltd., and Denkodo Co., Ltd. The remaining three subsidiaries support the group through staffing services, PC support, and delivery and construction work. Consolidated employees numbered 7,307 as of March 31, 2026.

By region, revenue was ¥59,737 million (7.9% share) in Ibaraki Prefecture, ¥55,057 million (7.2% share) in Hokkaido, and ¥57,055 million (7.5% share) in Chiba Prefecture, among others.

entries.81d5740d40a6e8e5: This business sells home appliances such as TVs, refrigerators and washing machines, PCs and their peripherals, and mobile phones through a home appliance mass retailer with multiple stores nationwide. Products are purchased centrally at the head office from domestic home appliance manufacturers, wholesalers and others, and sold to consumers through the stores of the company and 6 subsidiaries and through franchise member stores. The store brand is "K's Denki". The 6 subsidiaries are GIGAS Co., Ltd., Kansai K's Denki Co., Ltd., Big S Co., Ltd., Hokuetsu K's Co., Ltd., Kyushu K's Denki Co., Ltd. and Dencodo Co., Ltd., and the company holds 100.0% of the voting rights in each (as of March 31, 2026). The number of stores at the end of March 2026 was 556 (552 directly managed stores and 4 franchise stores). Sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥759,710 million (102.9% of the previous year), and net income was ¥14,317 million. The company cites as reasons for the sales increase that PCs remained strong after the end of support for Windows10, that the mobile phone replacement cycle arrived, and that air conditioners were strong owing to extreme heat and other factors. No segment information is stated; the business is a single category, and sales by business are not printed.

entries.da5c85b6157aa2b1: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥759,710 million (102.9% year on year). The total of ¥757,265 million in directly operated store revenue and ¥2,445 million in merchandise supply revenue to franchised member stores is mostly directly operated store revenue. By product category, mobile phones were ¥103,278 million (118.3% of the prior year), air conditioners ¥101,749 million (108.7%), washing machines ¥70,317 million, refrigerators ¥68,339 million, televisions ¥62,054 million, and PCs and information equipment ¥55,351 million (130.1%), among others. The company cites as reasons for the revenue increase that PCs remained strong after the end of Windows10 support, that mobile phones reached a replacement cycle, and that air conditioners were strong due to record-breaking heat, a Tokyo subsidy program, and pre-purchase demand ahead of the April 2027 raise in energy-saving standards.
